changes.name: KWRooms
changes.old:
structure KWRooms (S : Finset Sig) (T : Sig) where
  owns : Sig → Row → Row → Prop
  total : ∀ p n, bit p T=true → bit n T=false → ∃ v, owns v p n
  valid : ∀ {v p n}, owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false
  unique : ∀ {v w p n}, owns v p n → owns w p n → v=w
  rect : ∀ {v p n p' n'}, owns v p n' → owns v p' n → owns v p n
changes.new:
abbrev KWRooms (S : Finset Sig) (T : Sig) :=
  { owns : Sig → Row → Row → Prop //
    (∀ p n, bit p T=true → bit n T=false → ∃ v, owns v p n) ∧
    (∀ {v p n}, owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false) ∧
    (∀ {v w p n}, owns v p n → owns w p n → v=w) ∧
    (∀ {v p n p' n'}, owns v p n' → owns v p' n → owns v p n) }
abbrev KWRooms.owns {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) := D.val
abbrev KWRooms.total {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) := D.property.1
abbrev KWRooms.valid {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) :
    ∀ {v p n}, D.owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false := D.property.2.1
abbrev KWRooms.unique {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) :
    ∀ {v w p n}, D.owns v p n → D.owns w p n → v=w := D.property.2.2.1
abbrev KWRooms.rect {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) :
    ∀ {v p n p' n'}, D.owns v p n' → D.owns v p' n → D.owns v p n := D.property.2.2.2
def KWRooms.mk {S T} (owns : Sig → Row → Row → Prop)
    (total : ∀ p n, bit p T=true → bit n T=false → ∃ v, owns v p n)
    (valid : ∀ {v p n}, owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false)
    (unique : ∀ {v w p n}, owns v p n → owns w p n → v=w)
    (rect : ∀ {v p n p' n'}, owns v p n' → owns v p' n → owns v p n) : KWRooms S T :=
  ⟨owns,total,valid,unique,rect⟩

changes.name: FreeRooms
changes.old:
structure FreeRooms (S : Finset Sig) (T H : Sig) where
  owns : Sig → Row → Row → Prop
  total : ∀ p n, bit p T=true → bit n T=false →
    (bit p H=true ∧ bit n H=false) ∨ ∃ v, owns v p n
  valid : ∀ {v p n}, owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false
  unique : ∀ {v w p n}, owns v p n → owns w p n → v=w
  rect : ∀ {v p n p' n'}, owns v p n' → owns v p' n → owns v p n
changes.new:
abbrev FreeRooms (S : Finset Sig) (T H : Sig) :=
  { owns : Sig → Row → Row → Prop //
    (∀ p n, bit p T=true → bit n T=false → (bit p H=true ∧ bit n H=false) ∨ ∃ v, owns v p n) ∧
    (∀ {v p n}, owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false) ∧
    (∀ {v w p n}, owns v p n → owns w p n → v=w) ∧
    (∀ {v p n p' n'}, owns v p n' → owns v p' n → owns v p n) }
abbrev FreeRooms.owns {S T H} (D : FreeRooms S T H) := D.val
abbrev FreeRooms.total {S T H} (D : FreeRooms S T H) := D.property.1
abbrev FreeRooms.valid {S T H} (D : FreeRooms S T H) :
    ∀ {v p n}, D.owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false := D.property.2.1
abbrev FreeRooms.unique {S T H} (D : FreeRooms S T H) :
    ∀ {v w p n}, D.owns v p n → D.owns w p n → v=w := D.property.2.2.1
abbrev FreeRooms.rect {S T H} (D : FreeRooms S T H) :
    ∀ {v p n p' n'}, D.owns v p n' → D.owns v p' n → D.owns v p n := D.property.2.2.2
def FreeRooms.mk {S T H} (owns : Sig → Row → Row → Prop)
    (total : ∀ p n, bit p T=true → bit n T=false → (bit p H=true ∧ bit n H=false) ∨ ∃ v, owns v p n)
    (valid : ∀ {v p n}, owns v p n → v∈S ∧ bit p v=true ∧ bit n v=false)
    (unique : ∀ {v w p n}, owns v p n → owns w p n → v=w)
    (rect : ∀ {v p n p' n'}, owns v p n' → owns v p' n → owns v p n) : FreeRooms S T H :=
  ⟨owns,total,valid,unique,rect⟩

changes.name: SingleFactor
changes.old:
structure SingleFactor (S : Finset Sig) (T : Sig) where
  inner : Finset Sig
  outer : Finset Sig
  pivot : Sig
  cover : inner ∪ outer = S
  apart : Disjoint inner outer
  inside : KWRooms inner pivot
  outside : FreeRooms outer T pivot
changes.new:
abbrev SingleFactor (S : Finset Sig) (T : Sig) :=
  Σ inner : Finset Sig, Σ outer : Finset Sig, Σ pivot : Sig,
    { rooms : KWRooms inner pivot × FreeRooms outer T pivot //
      inner ∪ outer = S ∧ Disjoint inner outer }
abbrev SingleFactor.inner {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.1
abbrev SingleFactor.outer {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.2.1
abbrev SingleFactor.pivot {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.2.2.1
abbrev SingleFactor.cover {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.2.2.2.property.1
abbrev SingleFactor.apart {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.2.2.2.property.2
abbrev SingleFactor.inside {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.2.2.2.val.1
abbrev SingleFactor.outside {S T} (F : SingleFactor S T) := F.2.2.2.val.2
def SingleFactor.mk {S T} (inner outer : Finset Sig) (pivot : Sig)
    (cover : inner ∪ outer = S) (apart : Disjoint inner outer)
    (inside : KWRooms inner pivot) (outside : FreeRooms outer T pivot) : SingleFactor S T :=
  ⟨inner,outer,pivot,⟨inside,outside⟩,cover,apart⟩

changes.old:
structure PanelProof where

  tags : List PanelTag
  closed : panelClosed arity tags
changes.new:
abbrev PanelProof := Σ arity : Nat, { tags : List PanelTag // panelClosed arity tags }
abbrev PanelProof.arity (pc : PanelProof) := pc.1

abbrev PanelProof.closed (pc : PanelProof) : panelClosed pc.arity pc.tags := pc.2.property

changes.name: kwLeaf
changes.old:
def kwLeaf (T : Sig) : KWRooms {T} T where
  owns v p n := v=T ∧ bit p T=true ∧ bit n T=false
  total p n hp hn := ⟨T,rfl,hp,hn⟩
  valid := by rintro v p n ⟨rfl,hp,hn⟩; exact ⟨by simp,hp,hn⟩
  unique := by rintro v w p n ⟨rfl,_,_⟩ ⟨eq,_,_⟩; exact eq.symm
  rect := by rintro v p n p' n' ⟨e,hp,_⟩ ⟨_,_,hn⟩; exact ⟨e,hp,hn⟩
changes.new:
def kwLeaf (T : Sig) : KWRooms {T} T :=
  KWRooms.mk (fun v p n => v=T ∧ bit p T=true ∧ bit n T=false)
    (fun p n hp hn => ⟨T,rfl,hp,hn⟩)
    (by rintro v p n ⟨rfl,hp,hn⟩; exact ⟨by simp,hp,hn⟩)
    (by rintro v w p n ⟨rfl,_,_⟩ ⟨eq,_,_⟩; exact eq.symm)
    (by rintro v p n p' n' ⟨e,hp,_⟩ ⟨_,_,hn⟩; exact ⟨e,hp,hn⟩)

changes.name: freeFrom
changes.old:
def freeFrom {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) (h : Sig) : FreeRooms S T h where
  owns := D.owns
  total p n hp hn := Or.inr (D.total p n hp hn)
  valid := D.valid
  unique := D.unique
  rect := D.rect

changes.name: freeHide
changes.old:
def freeHide {S T h} (D : FreeRooms S T h) : FreeRooms (S.erase h) T h where
  owns v p n := v≠h ∧ D.owns v p n
  total := by
    intro p n hp hn
    rcases D.total p n hp hn with yes | ⟨v,hv⟩
    · exact Or.inl yes
    · by_cases eq : v=h
      · exact Or.inl (eq ▸ (D.valid hv).2)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨v,eq,hv⟩
  valid := by
    rintro v p n ⟨ne,hv⟩
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨ne,(D.valid hv).1⟩,(D.valid hv).2⟩
  unique := fun h1 h2 => D.unique h1.2 h2.2
  rect := fun a b => ⟨a.1,D.rect a.2 b.2⟩
changes.new:
def freeHide {S T h} (D : FreeRooms S T h) : FreeRooms (S.erase h) T h :=
  FreeRooms.mk (fun v p n => v≠h ∧ D.owns v p n)
    (by
      intro p n hp hn
      rcases D.total p n hp hn with yes | ⟨v,hv⟩
      · exact Or.inl yes
      · by_cases eq : v=h
        · exact Or.inl (eq ▸ (D.valid hv).2)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨v,eq,hv⟩)
    (by
      rintro v p n ⟨ne,hv⟩
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨ne,(D.valid hv).1⟩,(D.valid hv).2⟩)
    (fun h1 h2 => D.unique h1.2 h2.2)
    (fun a b => ⟨a.1,D.rect a.2 b.2⟩)

changes.name: factorOfTree
changes.old:
def factorOfTree {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) : SingleFactor S T where
  inner := S
  outer := ∅
  pivot := T
  cover := by simp
  apart := by simp
  inside := D
  outside := {
    owns := fun _ _ _ => False
    total := fun p n hp hn => Or.inl ⟨hp,hn⟩
    valid := fun h => h.elim
    unique := fun h _ => h.elim
    rect := fun h _ => h.elim }
changes.new:
def factorOfTree {S T} (D : KWRooms S T) : SingleFactor S T :=
  SingleFactor.mk S ∅ T (by simp) (by simp) D
    (FreeRooms.mk (fun _ _ _ => False)
      (fun p n hp hn => Or.inl ⟨hp,hn⟩)
      (fun h => h.elim) (fun h _ => h.elim) (fun h _ => h.elim))
